segment.source: This paper presents novel approaches to quantum error correction using topological codes. We demonstrate a 99.9% fidelity rate in quantum gate operations. The system utilizes superconducting qubits with coherence times exceeding 100 microseconds.
segment.target: 本文介绍了使用拓扑码进行量子纠错的新方法。我们展示了量子门操作中 99.9% 的保真度。该系统采用相干时间超过 100 微秒的超导量子比特。

segment.source: The results demonstrate significant improvements over previous systems. Key findings include: • Enhanced coherence times through improved shielding • Reduced error rates via advanced calibration techniques • Scalable architecture supporting >100 qubits • Cost reduction of ~30% compared to traditional methods
segment.target: 结果表明，与之前的系统相比，有了显著的改进。 主要发现包括： • 通过改进屏蔽增强了相干时间 • 通过先进的校准技术降低了错误率 • 可扩展的架构，支持>100个量子比特 • 与传统方法相比，成本降低了约30%

segment.source: This research establishes new benchmarks for quantum computing systems. Future work will focus on scaling to 1000+ qubits while maintaining high fidelity rates. The techniques developed here are applicable to various quantum computing architectures including trapped ions and photonic systems.
segment.target: 这项研究为量子计算系统建立了新的基准。 未来的工作将侧重于扩展到 1000+ 量子比特，同时保持高保真度。 此处开发的技术适用于各种量子计算架构，包括离子阱和光子系统。
